title: buildah copy --parents leaks host ancestor directories into the copied image
body:
### Issue Description

When working on PR #7157 I was going to add a test using `--include` and `--required-path` with `--parents` and noticed that `buildah copy --parents` is also copying the ancestor directories above the pivot point, i.e. real host filesystem path components like `/tmp/parents_bug` into the image as actual directory entries. I did confirm this against `main`

### Steps to reproduce the issue

```
mkdir -p /tmp/parent_bug/mytest/x

touch /tmp/parent_bug/mytest/x/a.txt

cid=$(buildah from scratch)

buildah copy --parents "$cid" /tmp/parent_bug/mytest/./x/a.txt /parents/

buildah unshare bash -c "
    mnt=\$(buildah mount $cid)
    find \"\$mnt\" -printf '%P\n' | sort
    buildah umount $cid"
```


### Describe the results you received

```
parents
parents/tmp
parents/tmp/parent_bug
parents/x
parents/x/a.txt
606bd4dd938f390b4e5fae48819f34fb23440442e194af6cd32847d280477c1c
```

### Describe the results you expected

```
parents
parents/x
parents/x/a.txt
606bd4dd938f390b4e5fae48819f34fb23440442e194af6cd32847d280477c1c
```
